# A0A7J5XRY7

## First Domain


Sequence [45-350]: 

### Homologies

Psi-blast search against Swiss-Prot:

```{r, echo=FALSE}
first_csvDir <- paste0(homedir,"first_psiblast.csv")
first_domain_homologs <- read.csv(first_csvDir)
colnames(first_domain_homologs) <- c("Receptor Name", "Organism", "Max Score", "Total Score", "Query Cover", "E value", "Percent Identity", "Accession Length", "Accession")

for (rowi in 1:nrow(first_domain_homologs)) {
  fullName <- first_domain_homologs[rowi,1]
  short_name <- strsplit(strsplit(first_domain_homologs$`Receptor Name`[rowi], ';')[[1]][1],"Full=")[[1]][2]
  first_domain_homologs[rowi,1] <- short_name
}

first_five <- first_domain_homologs[1:5,c(1,2,7,5,6)]
first_fifty <- first_domain_homologs[1:50,c(1,7)]
```

#### First 5 Full Homologues


```{r fiveH1, echo=FALSE}
(first_five)
```

#### First 50 Unique Homologues

```{r fiftyUnique1, echo=FALSE}
(first_fifty)
```

The similarity of the 50th match: 61% identity.

### Conservation

CXC chemokine receptor type 3-2, UniProt ID: E9QJ73


### Homologies

Psi-blast search against Swiss-Prot:

```{r, echo=FALSE}
second_csvDir <-paste0(homedir, "second_psiblast.csv")
second_domain_homologs <- read.csv(second_csvDir)
colnames(second_domain_homologs) <- c("Receptor Name", "Organism", "Max Score", "Total Score", "Query Cover", "E value", "Percent Identity", "Accession Length", "Accession")

for (rowi in 1:nrow(second_domain_homologs)) {
  fullName <- second_domain_homologs[rowi,1]
  short_name <- strsplit(strsplit(second_domain_homologs$`Receptor Name`[rowi], ';')[[1]][1],"Full=")[[1]][2]
  second_domain_homologs[rowi,1] <- short_name
}

first_five <- second_domain_homologs[1:5,c(1,2,7,5,6)]
first_fifty <- second_domain_homologs[1:50,c(1,7)]
```


#### First 5 Full Homologues


```{r fiveH2, echo=FALSE}
(first_five)
```



#### First 50 Unique Homologues

```{r fiftyUnique2, echo=FALSE}
(first_fifty)
```
